The transaction reported on this Form 4 was effected pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted by the Reporting Person on June 9, 2026. Represents a grant of restricted stock pursuant to and in accordance with the Issuer's director compensation policy, 100% of which will vest, subject to continued service through the vesting date, on the earlier of (i) October 7, 2027 or (ii) the date of the Issuer's next annual meeting of stockholders, subject to acceleration in full upon the occurrence of certain events.
